subject: general
question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹2500 as a sum borrowed at 3% per year rate of interest for 6 years.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total interest percentage = Rate × Time

Interest percentage = 3% × 6 = 18%

Simple Interest = 18% of 2500 = (18/100) × 2500

Simple Interest = 18 × 25 = 450

**∴ The correct answer is ₹450.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: Principal (P) = ₹2500, Rate (R) = 3% per annum, Time (T) = 6 years.

Formula: Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/70d8075958f30acad6cc4c34eedb8f3794705c5e591dbf4943d6cb57e83a718a.png] 

⇒ SI = (2500 × 3 × 6) ÷ 100

⇒ SI = (2500 × 18) ÷ 100

⇒ SI = 25 × 18

⇒ SI = 450

**∴ The correct answer is ₹450.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Amount (A)

The total amount to be repaid after the time period is the sum of the Principal and Simple Interest: A = P + SI.

Effective Rate of Interest

For simple interest, the total interest percentage over the entire duration is the product of the annual rate and the time in years (R × T).

Standard Units

Always ensure that the Time (T) is in years. If time is given in months, divide by 12; if in days, divide by 365 (or 366 for leap years).
